Title: Security Alarm System
Summary: Button Triggered alarm using motor, buzzer, and LED status system with secure feedback
Overview: This project involved designing, fabricating, and testing a multi-layer PCB for remote sensor telemetry. The primary constraint was minimizing power draw for solar-harvesting environments while ensuring continuous data logging over long-distance radio frequencies. The project code is found in GitHub in the link below.

StorySections.Heading: The Research Phase
StorySections.Paragraph: We started by mapping out power rails and evaluating low-dropout linear regulators (LDOs). Finding components with negligible quiescent current was critical because the circuit board needed to run autonomously for years without maintenance.

StorySections.Heading: Testing & Calibration
